task: Investigate whether EDE alleviates the CMB-BAO acoustic tension using DESI DR2 + Planck/ACT data, comparing LCDM, EDE, w0wa.
primary_data: DESI DR2 BAO (D_V/r_d, F_AP residuals at 7 z bins)
Planck NPIPE + ACT DR6 chi2 contributions (Tables II & III)
required_artifacts: 1D Gaussian posteriors for {Omega_m, H0, sigma8} across the three models
Reproduction of Figure 6 (Delta D_V/r_d, Delta F_AP, Delta mu) under each model
Delta chi2 / AIC comparison bar chart from Tables II & III
deviations_planned: We do not run a new MCMC: we use the published best-fit means + 1 sigma errors (Tables II/III) and treat them as Gaussian posteriors (paper-consistent simplification).
Background quantities D_M, D_H, D_V are computed with a flat FLRW solver in pure Python; rd is held fixed to the published value rd_fid = 147.0 Mpc unless stated.
